level.theme: Mystery is woven into every echo. The deeper you go, the more the ocean remembers — and the more it resists being forgotten.
level.setting: An ancient, half-buried underwater civilization, draped in bioluminescent kelp and moss. The water is thick with suspended particles, muting light and sound. Strange carvings pulse faintly with residual magic — the remnants of geomantic rituals long abandoned.
level.player_weapon: Geomancer Staff — emits seismic pulses that can be enhanced by pickups

enemy.name: Coral Wraith
enemy.weakness: Vulnerable to seismic pulses — its crystalline body fractures under low-frequency vibrations

encounters.hazard: Floating coral spires that emit sonic pulses when disturbed — these can be triggered to damage the enemy

pickup.name: Resonant Core
pickup.effect: Grants the player the ability to generate low-frequency seismic pulses with their Geomancer staff (passive)

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Coral Wraith causes the floor to crack open, revealing a hidden chamber beneath the archway — the next encounter’s entrance.

enemy.name: Silt Serpent
enemy.weakness: Disrupted by harmonic distortion — its body coils become unstable when exposed to layered frequencies

encounters.hazard: Whirling silt vortices that dampen movement and mask sound — player must use seismic pulses to reveal the serpent’s path

pickup.name: Echo Tuner
pickup.effect: Allows the player to layer two seismic pulses together, creating harmonic resonance (active ability: 'Harmonic Strike')

encounters.trigger: When the Silt Serpent is defeated, its body dissolves into glowing sediment that flows upward, forming a shimmering pathway to a long-forgotten temple — the boss arena.

enemy.name: The Stone Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Cracks when struck with amplified resonance — its petrified skin absorbs energy unless disturbed by layered frequencies

encounters.hazard: Petrified statues that emit protective harmonic shields when activated — player must use 'Harmonic Strike' to shatter them before attacking

pickup.name: Resonant Shard
pickup.effect: Reveals the Resonant Shard — a glowing, pulsing geode fragment that amplifies all seismic abilities

encounters.trigger: Upon defeat, the Sentinel collapses, revealing a hidden altar. The Resonant Shard activates and projects a vision of the Leviathan’s core — unlocking the final path.

boss.name: The Leviathan of Echoing Stone
boss.weakness: Vulnerable to harmonic resonance — any damage amplified by the Resonant Shard
boss.victory_condition: Strike its core with the Resonant Shard

level.objective: Collect the three resonance-enhancing items to weaken the Leviathan of Echoing Stone. Use each new ability to overcome the next guardian — culminating in a final strike with the Resonant Shard.
level.reward: The Heart of the Abyss — unlocks the ability to manipulate tectonic plates and summon localized tremors in future levels

level.setting: A tranquil, sun-dappled underwater realm where coral sings, jellyfish drift like lanterns, and the water itself feels alive with quiet rhythm. No violent currents. No sudden storms. Only peace — and the gentle call of the deep.
level.player_weapon: Sonic Whistle — emits low-frequency pulses that soothe or repel marine life

enemy.name: Glowfin Eel
enemy.weakness: Sonic Whistle (player weapon)

encounters.hazard: Dense kelp forest — slows movement but mutes enemy sound detection

pickup.name: Echo Coral Shard
pickup.effect: Activates Sonic Whistle’s echo pulse — reveals hidden paths and nearby enemies

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Glowfin Eel, the Echo Coral Shard glows and pulses toward the northeast, revealing a submerged tunnel lined with singing barnacles.

enemy.name: Sonic Scuttler
enemy.weakness: Echo Coral Shard (acquired in Encounter 1)

encounters.hazard: Resonance Fields — emit high-frequency pulses that disorient player if not buffered

pickup.name: Lullaby Shell
pickup.effect: Captures ambient ocean melodies — can be played as a calming song

encounters.trigger: When the Lullaby Shell is picked up, the water glows faintly blue, and distant, rhythmic vibrations begin — guiding the player toward the Abyssal Sanctum, where the Leviathan sleeps.

enemy.name: Deep Mantis Shrimp
enemy.weakness: Lullaby Shell (acquired in Encounter 2)

encounters.hazard: Pressure Vortexes — pull player toward walls if not anchored

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — this is the final encounter before the boss

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Deep Mantis Shrimp, the Lullaby Shell hums with renewed energy, and the seabed opens gently to reveal the Leviathan’s resting place — no combat needed, only a melody to play.

boss.name: The Whispering Leviathan
boss.victory_condition: Play the Lullaby Shell melody on the Leviathan’s forehead

level.objective: Use the power of harmony to calm the ocean’s guardians — not through force, but through song.
level.reward: The Leviathan opens its eyes, smiles with gentle bioluminescence, and gifts the Beastmaster with the Song of the Deep — unlocking all future ocean creatures as companions.

level.theme: Every death you cause echoes in the deep. Every soul you steal becomes a chain — and the Matriarch has been waiting for you to bind yourself to her.
level.setting: The level is set in a drowned ancient civilization, now a necropolis ruled by the Matriarch — a once-queen who sacrificed her people to become an eternal abomination. Bioluminescent algae glows sickly green, fish bones float like chandeliers, and the water itself feels thick and heavy, as if resisting the player’s movement. Silence is broken only by distant, wet heartbeats.
level.player_weapon: Soul-Siphon Chains (default) — chains that lash out, siphoning 1 HP/sec from enemies and storing it as soul energy. Can be upgraded by pickups.

encounters.location: Sunken Cathedral Ruins — broken pillars, floating bones, and drowned priests' corpses.

enemy.name: Gloomshard Leviathan
enemy.weakness: Its carapace is vulnerable to Soul-Siphon Chains (player’s default weapon ability). When the player uses Soul-Siphon Chains on it, 30% of its max HP is drained and converted into a temporary Soul Shard (pickup).

encounters.hazard: Darkwater Current — slows movement by 40% and drains 2 HP/sec unless the player stands in the glowing rifts (spawned after enemy death).

pickup.name: Soul Shard
pickup.effect: Soul Shard — a floating, pulsing fragment of the Leviathan’s soul. Picked up automatically on death. Grants 1 charge of 'Soul Chain Surge' — a single-use ability that fires 5 homing soul-bolts, dealing 10 damage each to all enemies in a 10m radius.

encounters.trigger: When the Leviathan dies, its corpse implodes, creating a vortex that pulls the player toward the next chamber. The vortex opens the collapsed tunnel to Encounter 2 and releases a wave of spectral eels that briefly blind the player (1s disorientation) — foreshadowing the next enemy’s sensory manipulation.

encounters.location: The Chamber of Muffled Screams — walls lined with petrified mouths, ceiling dripping viscous black fluid that slows time when touched.

enemy.name: Whispering Gorgon
enemy.weakness: Its eyes are sealed with coral and bone. It cannot be damaged by direct attacks. However, if the player activates 'Soul Chain Surge' (from the Soul Shard) while the Gorgon is mid-scream, the homing bolts pierce its sensory organs, shattering the coral and revealing its true form — then it becomes vulnerable to the Bone Shard Lash (a new weapon). The Bone Shard Lash is spawned from its corpse.

encounters.hazard: Echoing Silence Field — every 8 seconds, the Gorgon emits a pulse that silences all necromantic abilities (including Soul-Siphon Chains) for 4s. The field pulses in sync with the player’s heartbeat (visualized by red pulses in the environment).

pickup.name: Bone Shard Lash
pickup.effect: Bone Shard Lash — a whip formed from the Gorgon’s shattered bone-spikes, infused with its psychic agony. Deals 12 damage per lash. Can only be used to attack the boss. Cannot be used on regular enemies — it will phase through them unless they are under the effects of Soul Chain Surge (which the Gorgon is).

encounters.trigger: When the Gorgon dies, its final scream fractures the chamber ceiling. A massive, pulsing choker made of fossilized coral and spinal bone falls from above — the Heartstone Choker — and lands on the player’s inventory, vibrating with the Matriarch’s presence. The floor opens into the Abyssal Trench, revealing the boss’s lair.

encounters.location: The Sanctum of the Drowned Choir — a vast, circular chamber with seven altars, each holding a different drowned noble. The Prophet stands atop the central altar, surrounded by floating tomb-candles.

enemy.name: Drowned Prophet
enemy.weakness: It is immune to all damage unless the player has the Bone Shard Lash. Even then, it regenerates 3 HP/sec unless the player lashed it while standing inside one of the three glowing tomb-candles it summons (each candle cancels 1 HP/sec regeneration). The candles are only visible when the player uses Soul-Siphon Chains — revealing them as spectral runes.

encounters.hazard: Soul Drain Tides — every 12 seconds, the water level rises, and all non-boss enemies in the level respawn (including the Leviathan and Gorgon) unless the player has already killed them. If they are alive, they attack the Prophet, creating chaos. This is designed to punish hesitation.

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — this encounter is a trap. The Prophet’s death unlocks the boss chamber and confirms the player’s possession of the Bone Shard Lash and Soul Shard. If the player does not have the Bone Shard Lash, they cannot proceed — the path to the Matriarch remains sealed.

encounters.trigger: When the Drowned Prophet dies, his final whisper echoes: 'She wakes...'. The seven altars glow red, and the Heartstone Choker in the player’s inventory begins to burn. The floor collapses into the Matriarch’s throne room. The Prophet’s body dissolves into a black tide that seals the exit behind the player — no retreat.

boss.name: The Abyssal Matriarch
boss.weakness: The Heartstone Choker — a pulsing, fossilized relic fused to her chest — can only be shattered by the Bone Shard Lash (acquired in Encounter 2). Any other attack causes her to regenerate 5 HP/sec. She is immune to all other necromantic summons and soul-drains.
boss.victory_condition: Break the Heartstone Choker on her chest with the Bone Shard Lash

level.objective: Survive the Abyssal Trench and shatter the Heartstone Choker with the Bone Shard Lash to end the Matriarch’s eternal curse.
level.reward: The player gains the 'Abyssal Sovereign' title and unlocks the 'Soul Tether' passive: +2 HP/sec regeneration while standing in darkness, and the ability to summon one permanent spectral guardian from the first enemy’s soul (Leviathan).

level.theme: Tension comes from silence broken only by oppressive sound — your own breath, the hum of machinery, and the dread-inducing pulses of enemies that you can feel in your bones before you see them. Light is scarce. Oxygen is low. Every action has consequence.
level.setting: A decaying oceanic research complex, swallowed by the abyss, now inhabited by bio-mechanical horrors grown from failed experiments and ancient marine entities. The environment is alive — walls breathe, pipes throb with pressure, and distant sonar pulses echo like dying whales.
level.player_weapon: Stormcaller’s Chain Lightning Gauntlet — fires bolts that chain between targets but overheat. Must be charged manually. Overload Surge is a charged burst variant unlocked by SCA-1.

encounters.location: The Shattered Trench — narrow canyon with collapsing rock formations.

enemy.name: Gloomfin Stalker
enemy.weakness: Vulnerable to Overload Surge — the first ability unlocked by the Stormcaller's initial charge weapon.

encounters.hazard: Thick kelp forests that dampen movement and block line-of-sight. Pressure waves from the enemy cause temporary paralysis.

pickup.name: Storm Capacitor Array (SCA-1)
pickup.effect: Unlocks Overload Surge — a short-range, high-damage lightning burst that bypasses armor and stuns enemies.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Gloomfin Stalker causes its corpse to discharge residual energy into the trench walls, destabilizing the rock above and triggering a collapse that opens a new passage — leading directly to the next zone. The collapse also releases the SCA-1, embedded in a broken submersible.

encounters.location: The Resonance Chamber — a cathedral-like cavern filled with crystalline structures that amplify sound.

enemy.name: Echo Warden
enemy.weakness: Vulnerable to sustained Overload Surge bursts — its bio-sonic armor can be shattered by repeated Overload hits, revealing its core.

encounters.hazard: Active sonar fields that pulse every 8 seconds, revealing player position and attracting nearby debris. Player’s movement is silenced only while holding breath or in shadow zones.

pickup.name: Harmonic Resonance Crystal
pickup.effect: Grants Harmonic Resonance Crystal — a pulsing blue crystal that, when held, emits a controlled harmonic frequency that disrupts sonar and resonates with certain bio-mechanical systems.

encounters.trigger: When the Echo Warden is defeated, its core shatters and emits a final pulse. This pulse causes all crystalline structures in the chamber to vibrate in unison — revealing a hidden alcove where the Harmonic Resonance Crystal is suspended. The pulse also activates the final conduit — a glowing rift in the far wall, pulsing with the same frequency as the crystal — leading directly to the boss chamber.

encounters.location: The Siren’s Spire — a vertical, spiraling ruin with floating debris and gravity distortions.

enemy.name: Siren Queen
enemy.weakness: Vulnerable to the Harmonic Resonance Crystal’s frequency — when held and activated, it disrupts her neural link to the Leviathan, slowing her regeneration and exposing her heart.

encounters.hazard: Mind-siphoning song that drains player stamina and causes hallucinations (fake enemies, false paths). Player must stand still to resist, making them vulnerable. Pressure zones collapse randomly.

pickup.name: N/A
pickup.effect: None — the Harmonic Resonance Crystal is the only item required here, and it must be carried from Encounter 2.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Siren Queen causes her body to dissolve into a tide of bio-luminescent fluid, which flows into the central conduit. This activates the final pressure valve — opening the door to the Leviathan’s lair. The crystal’s frequency resonates with the conduit, hinting at the boss’s weakness.

boss.name: Leviathan of the Deep Void
boss.weakness: Vulnerable to harmonic frequencies amplified by the Harmonic Resonance Crystal — the only thing that can disrupt its bio-sonic shielding.
boss.victory_condition: Break its Core with the Harmonic Resonance Crystal

level.objective: Survive the three escalating encounters, collect the Harmonic Resonance Crystal in Encounter 2, and use it to shatter the Leviathan’s bio-sonic shield during the final fight.
level.reward: The player gains the 'Deep Conductor' title and unlocks the 'Resonance Pulse' upgrade — a passive that causes Overload Surge to leave behind a lingering harmonic field that damages nearby enemies over time.

level.theme: Eerie. The silence is not empty — it’s watching. Every current carries a whisper. Every light hides a watcher. The player does not fight the deep — the deep fights back through its forgotten children.
level.setting: A sunken temple of an ancient sea-cult, where the waters never stir, and the silence is thick enough to choke. Bioluminescent fungi pulse like dying stars. The deeper you go, the more the shadows breathe.
level.player_weapon: Shadowblade — silent, stealth-oriented dagger with a 3-second invisibility cooldown (30s base).

enemy.name: Deepshade Stalker
enemy.weakness: Vulnerable to Shadowblade’s silent movement — attacks made while undetected deal 2x damage. If the player remains motionless for 5 seconds in the current room, the Stalker loses aggro.

encounters.hazard: Floating jellyfish bioluminescence pulses every 8 seconds — light reveals player position. Silent movement avoids detection.

pickup.name: Echo Blade
pickup.effect: Echo Blade — a blade forged from a dead kraken’s bone, glows faintly when near harmonic frequencies.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Stalker causes the cavern ceiling to collapse, revealing a hidden tunnel choked with crystalline kelp — leading to the next zone. The Echo Blade glows brighter as the player approaches the kelp.

enemy.name: Siren of the Tear
enemy.weakness: Siren’s sonic lullaby disorients the player — but the Echo Blade resonates when near harmonic frequencies. Standing within the Echo Blade’s glow (within 2m) nullifies the lullaby. The Siren is immune to shadow strikes unless the blade is glowing.

encounters.hazard: Sonic pulses from the Siren cause the water to ripple violently — disrupting movement and visibility. Ripples follow a 12-second cycle. The Echo Blade glows in sync with the pulses when the player is near.

pickup.name: Harmonic Echo
pickup.effect: Harmonic Echo — a crystalline tear that pulses with the same frequency as the Echo Blade. When held, it tunes the blade to resonate with the Gloommaw’s core.

encounters.trigger: When the Siren is defeated, the Harmonic Echo is absorbed into the Echo Blade, causing it to emit a deep, resonant hum. The floor cracks open beneath the player, revealing a chasm lined with glowing veins — the path to the Gloommaw’s lair.

enemy.name: Benthic Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Protected by a shell of calcified coral that reflects all melee attacks. However, the Echo Blade — now tuned by the Harmonic Echo — emits a resonance pulse that destabilizes the coral when held at full power (hold attack for 2 seconds). The Sentinel is stunned for 3 seconds after each resonance pulse.

encounters.hazard: The chamber is filled with slow-moving pressure currents. Standing in them drains stamina and causes minor damage. The Echo Blade’s glow repels currents — but only if it’s glowing (i.e., after acquiring the Harmonic Echo).

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — this is a setup encounter. The only goal is to reach the boss chamber.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Sentinel causes its coral shell to shatter, revealing a massive bioluminescent vein in the wall — the Gloommaw’s heart. The Echo Blade pulses violently, vibrating in sync with the vein. The Gloommaw awakens.

boss.name: The Gloommaw
boss.weakness: The Gloommaw’s core is vulnerable only to the Echo Blade’s resonance frequency — which must be tuned by absorbing the Harmonic Echo from the Siren’s Tear.
boss.victory_condition: Shatter the Bioluminescent Core with the Echo Blade

level.objective: Navigate the drowned ruins, defeat three guardians, and shatter the Gloommaw’s core using the Echo Blade tuned by the Harmonic Echo.
level.reward: Gloommaw’s Crown — grants permanent underwater stealth and reduces enemy detection range by 50%.

level.theme: Chaos through opposing elements — fire vs. water, heat vs. ice, pressure vs. release — all amplified by the player's pyromantic presence.
level.setting: A collapsed underwater research facility buried in a trench of active volcanic vents and ancient coral ruins, where pressure, heat, and freezing currents collide in chaotic equilibrium.

enemy.name: Silt Scuttler
enemy.weakness: Player's Fire Bolt (basic attack)

encounters.hazard: Turbulent Silt Clouds (reduces visibility and movement speed by 40%)

pickup.name: Ignited Coral Core
pickup.effect: Fire Bolt upgrades to Inferno Bolt (area-of-effect flame burst on hit)

encounters.trigger: Silt Scuttler's death releases a pulse that shatters the coral-covered pressure valve above, flooding the next chamber with superheated water — activating the next encounter.

enemy.name: Thermal Leviathan
enemy.weakness: Inferno Bolt (from Encounter 1 pickup)

encounters.hazard: Geothermal Vents (deal 10 damage/sec to player if standing in them, but temporarily increase fire damage by 25% when active)

pickup.name: Burning Bubble Core
pickup.effect: Player gains 'Burning Bubble' — a temporary shield that explodes in a 5m radius when broken, dealing fire damage

encounters.trigger: Thermal Leviathan's death causes its core to rupture, spewing molten gas into the cavern ceiling. The heat melts the ice seals above the final chamber, revealing The Maw of Deep Ember.

enemy.name: Abyssal Cold-Singer
enemy.weakness: Burning Bubble Core (must be activated while standing in the enemy's ice field)

encounters.hazard: Cryo-Frost Fields (slow movement by 70%, extinguish all player flames unless protected by Burning Bubble)

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — this is the final encounter before the boss

encounters.trigger: Abyssal Cold-Singer's death shatters the last cryo-dam, unleashing a torrent of superheated water and magma that breaches the final vault — exposing The Maw of Deep Ember in its lair.

level.objective: Survive the three escalating encounters and defeat the boss by exploiting its vulnerability to the Ignited Coral Core
level.reward: The Emberheart Scepter — grants permanent fire resistance and turns all fire attacks into AoE explosions

level.theme: You are not here to fight the Leviathan. You are here to finish what you started — and the Leviathan knows you. It remembers your voice. It remembers your weapon. It remembers your failure.
level.setting: A drowned, ancient civilization built into the abyssal plain. No sunlight. Only bioluminescent decay and the groaning of pressure-stressed metal. The player, a lone Warden, is the last guardian of a failed protocol meant to contain the Leviathan — now awakened. The level is silent except for the player’s breathing, the creak of the suit, and the occasional, distant thrum of the beast below. Water is thick with sediment. No allies. No save points. No mercy.
level.player_weapon: Warden’s Cry — a sonic emitter that fires a focused pulse (base mode) and can be enhanced with pickups

encounters.location: The Silted Ruins — a collapsed temple of drowned architects

enemy.name: Gloommaw – The Tethered Warden
enemy.weakness: The Warden’s Cry (player’s primary weapon — sonic pulse)

encounters.hazard: Bio-luminescent silt that distorts vision and slows movement by 40%

pickup.name: Resonance Core Fragment
pickup.effect: Unlocks Warden’s Cry: Echo Mode — a delayed, area-denial sonic pulse that lingers for 4s after activation

encounters.trigger: After defeating Gloommaw, the resonant pulse destabilizes the ceiling, causing a cascade of collapsed pillars to reveal a submerged pressure valve leading to the next zone.

encounters.location: The Chamber of Echoes — a cavern lined with crystalline resonators that absorb all sound

enemy.name: The Silence-Spinner
enemy.weakness: Echo Mode (from Resonance Core Fragment)

encounters.hazard: Absolute Sound Nullification Field — disables all non-physical attacks (including player weapon’s base mode), forces melee-only engagement

pickup.name: Dampener Matrix
pickup.effect: Unlocks Sonic Dampener Field — a temporary 8s bubble that inverts the Nullification Field, allowing Warden’s Cry to function normally within it

encounters.trigger: When the Silence-Spinner dies, its body collapses into a pool of liquid sonics. The Dampener Matrix activates, and the pool drains upward, revealing a jagged fissure pulsing with deep-blue energy — the entrance to the Trench.

encounters.location: The Sentinel Spire — a towering, inverted spire anchored to the trench floor

enemy.name: The Final Keeper — A Failed Warden
enemy.weakness: Dampener Matrix (must activate to negate its harmonic shield)

encounters.hazard: Harmonic Feedback Storm — pulses of destructive resonance that scale in intensity every 12 seconds. Player must time movement to avoid being shattered.

pickup.name: Shattered Harmonic Resonator
pickup.effect: Unlocks Shattered Harmonic Resonator — a handheld device that emits a targeted, high-frequency pulse capable of disrupting biological and mechanical harmonics

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Final Keeper causes the spire’s core to fracture. The Resonator is ejected from its chest cavity and floats into the player’s hands. Simultaneously, the trench floor rips open, revealing the Leviathan’s massive, dormant form below — its three Anchors now visible, each glowing with the same frequency as the Resonator.

boss.name: The Leviathan of the Forgotten Trench
boss.weakness: The Shattered Harmonic Resonator (acquired from Encounter 3)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Core after severing all three Anchors

level.objective: Use the Shattered Harmonic Resonator to disrupt each of the Leviathan’s three Anchors (in sequence), then deliver a final pulse to its exposed Core while it is vulnerable. Each Anchor must be destroyed using the Resonator in sync with the Leviathan’s breathing cycle — a 15s window that opens only after the prior Anchor is severed.
level.reward: The Warden’s Oath — a passive upgrade: all future sonic attacks ignore 50% of enemy resistance and restore 10% health on critical hits.

level.theme: Every enemy is cute, absurd, and vulnerable to the player’s own illusions — turning the power of deception into salvation.
level.setting: A sunken palace of coral and glass, where sea creatures dance in bubbles and light bends like a funhouse mirror. The water is warm, glittering, and smells faintly of candyfloss and salt.
level.player_weapon: Whimsy Wand — casts floating, slow-moving illusions (Mirror Bubble, Prism Coral beam) that reflect or distort the environment.

enemy.name: Squishy Squidlet
enemy.weakness: Disappears when hit by a Mirror Bubble — it hates seeing its own reflection

encounters.hazard: Glowing jellyfish drift lazily, creating soft light pools. Touching them stuns briefly.

pickup.name: Mirror Bubble Orb
pickup.effect: Creates a shimmering, slow-moving Mirror Bubble that reflects light in a 90° arc. Lasts 8 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Squidlet causes a hidden cave entrance to open in the coral wall, revealing a tunnel filled with floating prisms.

enemy.name: Prism Jelly
enemy.weakness: Shatters when hit by reflected light from the Mirror Bubble — it’s made of fragile crystalized bioluminescence

encounters.hazard: Floating prisms refract light randomly. Standing in wrong color beams causes temporary color-blindness (player sees inverted hues).

pickup.name: Prism Coral
pickup.effect: Summons a floating, stationary Prism Coral that absorbs light and emits a focused, persistent beam of rainbow light when activated.

encounters.trigger: Shattering the Prism Jelly causes the coral to glow brightly and drift upward into a sunlit shaft — the only path to the boss chamber.

enemy.name: Bubbler Blenny
enemy.weakness: Cannot hold its bubbles if hit by the Prism Coral’s focused beam — the light destabilizes its bubble sacs

encounters.hazard: Bubbles that float upward explode into confetti clouds that briefly obscure vision and grant temporary invincibility to enemies.

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — this is the final encounter before the boss.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Bubbler Blenny causes the ceiling to ripple open, revealing the boss chamber with a glowing throne of coral and the Gilded Grouper waiting, shimmering with stolen light.

boss.name: The Gilded Grouper
boss.weakness: Reflects its own glitter attack when hit by reflected light
boss.victory_condition: Reflect its own glitter onto it using the Prism Coral

level.objective: Use illusion-based magic to outwit and reflect the weaknesses of three whimsical sea creatures, culminating in turning the boss’s own dazzling beauty against it.
level.reward: A crown of living seagrass that lets the player summon a harmless, dancing octopus companion for the next level.

level.theme: Chaos is the only constant. Order is a lie whispered by the dead.
level.setting: The jungle is alive — vines writhe like serpents, trees scream when cut, and the air thrums with unseen predators. Sound is both weapon and curse. Time bends near fungal growths. The Beastmaster doesn't just command beasts — they must dance with the chaos itself.
level.player_weapon: Firebrand (flame-infused whip, primary attack: whip lash, secondary: ignite target)

enemy.name: Vine Warden
enemy.weakness: Vulnerable to Firebrand (player's default weapon) when ignited by Flamefruit

encounters.hazard: Toxic Vine Fields (damages player over time unless standing on stone pads)

pickup.name: Flamefruit
pickup.effect: Grants temporary immunity to poison and emits a faint thermal pulse for 15s

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Vine Warden causes the ground to rupture, releasing a swarm of Burrowing Stingers toward the next zone

enemy.name: Burrowing Stingers
enemy.weakness: Vulnerable to sonic disruption — only damaged by attacks synced with their vibration rhythm (detected via Flamefruit's thermal pulse)

encounters.hazard: Quaking Earth (random tremors disorient movement and silence beastmaster commands for 3s)

pickup.name: Crown of Thorns
pickup.effect: Grants the Crown of Thorns — a headpiece that emits controlled sonic pulses when activated (cooldown: 8s). Also reveals enemy weak points via harmonic resonance.

encounters.trigger: The final Stinger’s death emits a deafening shriek, shattering the tunnel ceiling and revealing a colossal fungal nest above — the lair of the Matriarch

enemy.name: Fungal Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Vulnerable to the Crown of Thorns’ sonic pulses when its spore-gills are exposed (activated after 2 successful sonic hits)

encounters.hazard: Spore Clouds (obscure vision, drain stamina, and cause hallucinations — player sees fake enemies)

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — this is the final encounter before the boss

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Fungal Sentinel collapses the fungal ceiling, exposing the Matriarch’s nest above. Roots burst upward, forming a ritual platform for the final battle.

boss.name: The Howling Matriarch
boss.weakness: Vulnerable to sonic pulses emitted by the Crown of Thorns (acquired in Encounter 2)
boss.victory_condition: Deplete health while using the Crown of Thorns

level.objective: Survive the jungle’s chaos by mastering each encounter’s unique environmental chaos and weapon synergy. Only by chaining pickups and adapting to the jungle’s rhythm can the Beastmaster claim the Crown and silence the Matriarch’s song.
level.reward: Crown of Thorns becomes permanent passive: grants harmonic perception (reveals hidden enemies and weak points) and +10% beast command efficiency.

level.theme: Mysterious, ancient, and alive — nature as a sentient, vengeful force.
level.setting: A forgotten jungle where time is distorted by ancient relics. Mist clings to the trees like living fog, and shadows move when no one is watching. The air hums with unseen energy — the jungle remembers, and it watches you.

enemy.name: Thornmaw Stalker
enemy.weakness: Player’s Tranquilizer Dart (primary weapon mod)

encounters.hazard: Toxic Vines (slow movement, -10% speed)

pickup.name: Whisperleaf Darts
pickup.effect: Unlocks Tranquilizer Dart mod (primary weapon)

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Stalker, the vines retract, revealing a hidden path lined with glowing fungi that hum faintly — leading to Encounter 2

enemy.name: Echoing Shade
enemy.weakness: Heartstone Shard (acquired from Encounter 1 pickup)

encounters.hazard: Sonic Pulse Fields (disrupts aiming, causes screen distortion)

pickup.name: Heartstone Shard
pickup.effect: Grants Heartstone Shard — a pulsing crystal that resonates with ancient energy

encounters.trigger: When the Shade is defeated, the shard glows violently. The cavern walls crack open, revealing a hidden altar beneath a canopy of bioluminescent trees — leading to the boss arena

enemy.name: Rootbound Goliath
enemy.weakness: Heartstone Shard (acquired from Encounter 2)

encounters.hazard: Entangling Roots (grabs player, deals 15 damage/sec until freed)

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — this is the final encounter before the boss

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Goliath, its body dissolves into vines that unravel into the floor, exposing the altar where the Veil-Warden rests. The Heartstone Shard vibrates in sync with the boss’s core.

boss.name: The Veil-Warden
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Heartstone core after it’s exposed

level.objective: Survive the jungle’s guardians and destroy the Veil-Warden using the Heartstone Shard to destabilize its core.
level.reward: Veil-Touched Amulet — grants stealth in foliage and immunity to toxic vines

level.theme: Tense. Silent. Unforgiving. You are not the hunter. You are the prey learning to hunt.
level.setting: A primordial jungle choked with ancient, sentient flora and predatory fauna. The air hums with insectile dread. Every shadow moves. Every rustle is a death sentence.

enemy.name: Stalk-Snare Vine Warden
enemy.weakness: Player’s Dagger (default weapon) — slashing the vine-tendrils disrupts its motion

encounters.hazard: Spike-vines that lash out every 3 seconds in a 180° arc. Player must dodge or use cover.

pickup.name: Poisoned Dagger
pickup.effect: Grants the player the ‘Poisoned Dagger’ — +5 damage, applies slow poison on hit (2 damage/sec for 5 sec).

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Warden, the vines part to reveal a hidden tunnel leading to the next zone. The poison residue on the dagger begins to fume faintly — hinting at its latent potency.

enemy.name: Jungle Shade Assassin
enemy.weakness: Poisoned Dagger — its slow poison reduces the Assassin’s speed and makes its shadow-step predictable

encounters.hazard: Total darkness except for intermittent moonbeams. Enemy teleports between light patches. Player’s vision is reduced to 10ft radius unless standing in moonlight.

pickup.name: Echo Vial
pickup.effect: Grants the ‘Echo Vial’ — when thrown, reveals enemy position for 4 seconds via sonar pulse. One use.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Assassin causes his cloak to dissolve into glowing fungal spores. These spores cling to the Poisoned Dagger, causing its poison to pulse with violet light — and triggering the Matriarch’s alarm.

enemy.name: Mantis Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Echo Vial — reveals its camouflage and exposes the vulnerable joint between its forelimbs

encounters.hazard: Floor covered in razor-sharp leaf-blooms that deal 3 damage per second if stood on. Only safe paths are lit by bioluminescent fungi that fade after 10 seconds.

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — this is the final encounter before the boss. Player retains Poisoned Dagger and Echo Vial.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeat, the Sentinel’s carapace cracks open, revealing a vine-woven egg sac suspended above a pit — the Matriarch’s lair. The sac pulses with the same violet glow as the poisoned dagger. The player must now climb the vines to reach the boss chamber.

boss.name: The Viper Matriarch
boss.victory_condition: Strike the glowing egg sac on her back with the Poisoned Dagger

level.objective: Survive the jungle. Collect the tools. Exploit their weaknesses. Kill the Matriarch before her eggs hatch.
level.reward: The Matriarch’s Heart — a relic that grants +30% damage with poisons and unlocks the ‘Silent Venom’ upgrade tree.

level.theme: Peace through understanding, not force. The Warden heals the jungle by aligning with its rhythms, not by overwhelming it.
level.setting: The Whispering Jungle — a lush, mist-draped ecosystem where ancient trees hum with quiet energy. Gentle waterfalls, glowing moss, and floating pollen create a tranquil, dreamlike atmosphere. No violence is natural here — the player is the first to bring the edge of a blade into this harmony.
level.player_weapon: Tranquil Dagger — silently stuns enemies on hit. Grants bonus damage in sunlight.

enemy.name: Thorned Monitor Lizard
enemy.weakness: Warden's Tranquil Dagger (primary weapon) — deals bonus damage when used while standing in Sunbeams

encounters.hazard: Intermittent sunbeams that pierce the canopy

pickup.name: Sunbeam Compass
pickup.effect: Grants temporary Sunbeam Sensitivity — highlights sunbeams on minimap for 60 seconds

encounters.trigger: After defeating the lizard, the Sunbeam Compass activates and reveals a hidden vine path leading to the next clearing. The path glows faintly blue where sunbeams are strongest.

enemy.name: Chorus Moths
enemy.weakness: Sunbeam Compass — when activated, the moths flee from bright light, revealing their central Hive Nest

encounters.hazard: Dense cloud of moths that obscures vision and drains stamina over time

pickup.name: Bloom Charm
pickup.effect: Emits a soft bioluminescent glow that attracts beneficial flora. Used to bloom the Heartvine.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the moths causes the Bloom Charm to drop from the Hive Nest. The charm pulses rhythmically, drawing the player toward a pulsing, ancient tree deeper in the jungle — the Matriarch’s sanctuary.

enemy.name: Root Warden Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Bloom Charm — when held near its root-core, the charm causes the roots to wither and retreat

encounters.hazard: Entangling roots that slow movement and trigger ground spikes

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — this is the final encounter before the boss

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Sentinel, the ground splits open to reveal the Heartvine — the core of the Guardian Vine Matriarch. The Bloom Charm flares brightly, signaling the boss is vulnerable.

boss.name: Guardian Vine Matriarch
boss.victory_condition: Use the Bloom Charm to sever the Heartvine

level.objective: Use the power of nature’s harmony to restore balance to the Whispering Jungle.
level.reward: The Heartvine blooms into a radiant canopy. The jungle becomes permanently peaceful. Birds return. The Warden is granted the title: Keeper of Serenity.

level.theme: The jungle is not alive — it is *remembering*. Every enemy is a memory of someone who tried to control death... and became part of it.
level.setting: An ancient jungle where trees are fused with the bones of long-dead necromancers. Vines writhe like serpents. The air is thick with the scent of rot and incense. The sky is permanently overcast, lit only by bioluminescent fungi and the faint glow of trapped souls in the canopy.
level.player_weapon: Necrotic Staff (basic soul-drain beam, 15 damage, 10s cooldown)

enemy.name: Gloomfang Stalker
enemy.weakness: Vulnerable to Bone Shards (from Encounter 1 pickup)

encounters.hazard: Toxic Fog (slowly drains HP, obscures vision)

pickup.name: Bone Shards
pickup.effect: Collect 5 Bone Shards from defeated Stalker's corpse. These shards can be thrown as ranged projectiles, dealing 30 damage and leaving a lingering necrotic residue on enemies.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Gloomfang Stalker causes the ground to crack open beneath it, revealing a hidden root tunnel that leads to the next zone — and the shrieking of unseen creatures echoes from within.

enemy.name: Witchvine Revenant
enemy.weakness: Vulnerable to necrotic residue left by Bone Shards (from Encounter 1 pickup)

encounters.hazard: Living Vines (grab and immobilize player if not burned or necrotized)

pickup.name: Bone Chime
pickup.effect: The Revenant drops a Bone Chime — a hollow femur carved with spiraling runes. When shaken, it emits a low harmonic pulse that resonates with necrotic energy. This pulse reveals hidden paths and weakens undead entities within 10m. The chime also attracts hostile flora and fauna if used excessively.

encounters.trigger: When the Witchvine Revenant dies, its corpse dissolves into black sap that flows downhill — forming a pulsating root-path that leads directly to the Heartstone Chamber. The Bone Chime begins to hum faintly, as if drawn to something deeper.

enemy.name: Carrion Choir
enemy.weakness: Vulnerable to Bone Chime resonance — its spectral voices are silenced when the chime's frequency matches its harmonic dissonance (activated during boss phase)

encounters.hazard: Soul Siphon Tendrils (drain player mana when near; replenish enemy health)

pickup.name: Echo of the Fallen
pickup.effect: None — the Choir does not drop items. Instead, it sings a dirge that temporarily amplifies the Bone Chime’s resonance, unlocking a hidden memory: the Matriarch’s Heartstone was once a child’s ribcage, now fused with the ancient tree. The resonance frequency is imprinted into the player’s mind.

encounters.trigger: Upon the Choir’s defeat, the ground trembles. The roots beneath the player’s feet rise and form a stairway into the canopy — the Heartstone Chamber. The Bone Chime now pulses with a steady, urgent rhythm, guiding the player toward the final confrontation.

boss.name: The Veilroot Matriarch
boss.weakness: The Heartstone on its chest is vulnerable only to the resonance of the Bone Chime — which must be activated within 5 seconds of its pulse cycle.
boss.victory_condition: Shatter the Heartstone with the Bone Chime

level.objective: Survive the jungle’s cursed guardians and shatter the Matriarch’s Heartstone with the Bone Chime’s resonance. Failure results in the player becoming a new vessel for the Veilroot’s hunger.
level.reward: The player gains the ability to raise the defeated Matriarch as a permanent spectral companion — a twisted guardian of the jungle’s darkest secrets.

level.theme: Whimsical Alchemy — magic made of giggles, glitter, and gentle chaos.
level.setting: A jungle where trees giggle when the wind blows, vines play hide-and-seek, and mushrooms glow like lanterns. Colorful butterflies leave trails of confetti. Everything is soft, bouncy, and slightly absurd.
level.player_weapon: Chromatic Retort Flask (shoots slow, bouncing alchemical blobs that can be upgraded by pickups)

enemy.name: Sneezy Vine Sprites
enemy.weakness: Cure-all Elixir (obtained from defeating them)

encounters.hazard: Toxic Pollen Clouds (slowly drain health if standing still)

pickup.name: Cure-all Elixir
pickup.effect: Drops a vial of Cure-all Elixir — instantly heals 20 HP and grants immunity to Toxic Pollen for 30s

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Vine Sprites causes a hidden vine to retract, revealing a path to a glowing mushroom patch (Encounter 2).

enemy.name: Glowcap Gargoyles
enemy.weakness: Cure-all Elixir (from Encounter 1)

encounters.hazard: Flickering Shadows (disorient player briefly if not moving)

pickup.name: Sparkling Pollen
pickup.effect: Drops Sparkling Pollen — a shimmering dust that glows when held; reveals hidden paths and weak points on enemies

encounters.trigger: When the Glowcap Gargoyles are defeated, their glowing caps burst into light, illuminating a path of floating lily pads leading to the Ancient Alchemy Tree (Boss Fight).

enemy.name: Whispering Mimic Vines
enemy.weakness: Sparkling Pollen (from Encounter 2)

encounters.hazard: Illusory Pathways (player must follow true path lit by Sparkling Pollen)

pickup.name: Whimsy Sap
pickup.effect: Drops a single vial of Whimsy Sap — not usable as weapon, but when thrown, it causes vines to dance and momentarily pause

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Mimic Vines causes the Ancient Alchemy Tree to shudder, its bark splitting open to reveal the Giggling Golem sleeping inside — the final boss.

boss.name: The Giggling Golem
boss.victory_condition: Apply the Sparkling Pollen to its core

level.objective: Collect the three alchemical components to awaken and pacify the Giggling Golem — a guardian of the jungle’s forgotten laughter.
level.reward: The Giggling Golem dissolves into giggles and rains down glittering seeds — unlocking the ‘Jungle Jester’ title and granting the player a new ability: ‘Laughter Lure’ — charm minor creatures for 10s.

level.theme: Time is not linear here — it is a wound. Every step echoes. Every breath is remembered. To survive, you must not only control time — but unravel it.
level.setting: A forgotten jungle temple swallowed by overgrowth, where time is fractured. Sunlight pierces through thick canopy in fractured beams. The air hums with dissonant chimes, and shadows move independently of their sources. The ground is littered with broken hourglasses and petrified creatures caught mid-motion.
level.player_weapon: Chrono-Weave — basic ability: slow enemies in a cone (2s duration, 15s cooldown). Upgrade: Stasis Pulse unlocks after Encounter 1.

enemy.name: Vine-Snarler
enemy.weakness: Stasis Pulse (from player’s default weapon) freezes its root-network, making it vulnerable to follow-up strikes. The enemy regenerates if not frozen within 3 seconds of first attack.

encounters.hazard: Spore Clouds that reduce visibility and drain stamina over time. Players must time movement to avoid them.

pickup.name: Stasis Pulse Module (passive upgrade to Chrono-Weave)
pickup.effect: Unlocks Stasis Pulse (LMB + Hold) — briefly freezes all living targets in a 3m radius for 2.5s. Cooldown: 12s.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Vine-Snarler, the ruins begin to tremble. A section of the ceiling collapses, revealing a hidden passage lit by flickering blue light — leading to the Echo Grove.

enemy.name: Echo Wisp
enemy.weakness: The Stasis Pulse (acquired in Encounter 1) traps the Wisp in a time-loop, causing it to replay its last 2 seconds of movement. During this loop, it becomes immobile and takes 200% damage from any source.

encounters.hazard: Time Echoes — after a player moves or attacks, ghostly afterimages of their actions appear 3 seconds later and can be triggered by enemies to attack or distract. Player must learn to move unpredictably.

pickup.name: Echo Shard
pickup.effect: Reveals the Echo Shard — a crystalline fragment that, when held, allows the player to briefly rewind time by 1.5 seconds (once per fight). This creates a visible temporal distortion zone around the player.

encounters.trigger: When the Echo Wisp is defeated, it shatters into prismatic shards that coalesce into the Echo Shard. The ground beneath the player cracks open, revealing a pulsating obsidian monolith — the portal to the Chrono-Temple, where the Chrono-Wraith waits.

enemy.name: Spectral Lurker
enemy.weakness: The Echo Shard (acquired in Encounter 2) can be activated to rewind the Lurker’s last movement. If the player rewinds while the Lurker is mid-ambush, it becomes physically exposed for 4 seconds, taking 150% damage from all sources.

encounters.hazard: Phantom Vines — invisible tendrils that grab the player if they remain still for over 2 seconds. The vines can be revealed by activating the Echo Shard’s rewind effect.

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — this encounter is a gauntlet to prepare for the boss. Victory unlocks the final chamber.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Lurker, the walls bleed dark chronal energy. The ground becomes unstable. A final portal opens — the Chrono-Temple, where time fractures into overlapping moments. The Chrono-Wraith awakens.

boss.name: The Chrono-Wraith
boss.weakness: The Echo Shard (acquired in Encounter 2) disrupts its temporal anchor. Only when the Wraith is slowed by the player’s Chrono-Weave ability can the shard be used to destabilize its core.
boss.victory_condition: Strike the Chrono-Wraith with the Echo Shard while it is in Slow Mode

level.objective: Defeat the Chrono-Wraith by using the Echo Shard during its Slow Mode — which is triggered when the player activates Chrono-Weave while holding the Echo Shard.
level.reward: Temporal Cloak — allows player to become briefly invisible while moving, and reduces cooldowns of all time abilities by 20%.

level.theme: The jungle is not a place — it is a living wound. You are its infection. Kill to live. Resonate to remember. And when you strike the final blow — you will hear the forest scream… and you will scream back.
level.setting: An ancient jungle where the trees are petrified with fungal bone, and the air hums with the ghosts of dead tribes. The silence is not empty — it’s hungry. The player is the last berserker of a fallen war-clan, drawn here by a song only their weapon can hear. There are no allies. No maps. No mercy.
level.player_weapon: Rusted Bone Cleaver — slow, heavy swings, 25 damage per hit, no ranged options. No healing items. Only regeneration comes from killing enemies within 3 seconds of taking damage — 10 HP per kill.

enemy.name: Thornback Stalker
enemy.weakness: Vulnerable to the ‘Sonic Screech’ effect — its armored hide shatters when struck by a weapon pulse after consuming the Howler’s Fang.

encounters.hazard: Thick, silent vines that drain 5 HP/sec if the player stands still for more than 3 seconds. Movement is muted, making stealth impossible.

pickup.name: Howler’s Fang
pickup.effect: Grants the player the ‘Howler’s Fang’ — a bone fragment that, when held, causes the Berserker’s weapon to emit a high-pitched sonic pulse on every 3rd consecutive hit (1.5s cooldown). The pulse stuns enemies for 0.8s and reveals hidden traps.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Stalker causes the vines ahead to wither, revealing a collapsed temple entrance. The Fang activates only if the player has swung their weapon at least 12 times during the fight.

enemy.name: Gutgut the Hollowed
enemy.weakness: Exposed internal organs ignite upon contact with the ‘Sonic Resonance’ emitted by the Howler’s Fang — damage is amplified 3x if the pulse strikes during its inhalation phase (every 12 seconds).

encounters.hazard: Pools of toxic sludge that spawn swarming, fast-moving parasitic flies. Contact applies ‘Rot’ — reduces max HP by 10% per second until healed. Only cured by killing an enemy while holding the Howler’s Fang.

pickup.name: Heartstone
pickup.effect: Reveals a pulsing, bioluminescent Heartstone embedded in the enemy’s chest. When collected, it emits a soft harmonic tone and links to the player’s weapon, allowing one charged resonance blast per minute (requires holding the attack button for 2 seconds).

encounters.trigger: Killing Gutgut with a Sonic Resonance pulse causes the temple ceiling to crack open, raining down vines that form a spiral path upward — leading directly to the Matriarch’s chamber. The Heartstone’s tone will grow louder the longer the player delays entering the final area.

encounters.location: The Womb of the Last Mother

enemy.name: The Hollow Matriarch
enemy.weakness: Vulnerable to Sonic Resonance — only takes full damage when the player’s weapon emits a pulse matching the Heartstone’s frequency. The Matriarch’s chitinous shell hardens if the player hasn’t used the Heartstone within 60 seconds of last encounter.

encounters.hazard: The entire arena is a hollowed-out tree root system. Every 15 seconds, the ground splits open, ejecting spore clouds that silence the player’s weapon for 4 seconds unless they’re holding the Heartstone. Only the Heartstone can amplify weapon pulses to break the shell.

pickup.name: Heartstone
pickup.effect: Heartstone (acquired from Gutgut) — must be used to activate weapon resonance. The Heartstone’s frequency must be synced manually by holding attack for 2s — failure causes the Matriarch to roar and gain 20% damage resistance for 10s.

encounters.trigger: The Matriarch only awakens when the player enters the chamber. She begins by summoning 3 spectral Stalkers — each must be killed to weaken her shell. Killing the third Stalker causes the Heartstone to glow intensely, activating the resonance window.

boss.name: The Hollow Matriarch
boss.weakness: Vulnerable to Sonic Resonance — only takes full damage when the player’s weapon emits a pulse matching the Heartstone’s frequency. The Matriarch’s chitinous shell hardens if the player hasn’t used the Heartstone within 60 seconds of last encounter.
boss.victory_condition: Deal 100+ damage to the Matriarch within 3 seconds of activating the Heartstone

level.objective: Survive the jungle’s decay by weaponizing its horrors — each enemy’s death must be a catalyst for the next. The final boss cannot be harmed without the Heartstone, and the Heartstone can only be obtained by using the Howler’s Fang correctly. Failure to chain the mechanics results in overwhelming, unblockable attacks and no healing.
level.reward: The player unlocks the ‘Soul Echo’ passive: next playthrough, the Howler’s Fang and Heartstone are permanently integrated into the weapon — granting unlimited resonance pulses. But the jungle remembers… and adapts.
